preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= k <= n <= 3 * 10**5 for n, k in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the string n and the parameter k satisfy 2 <= k <= n <= 3 * 10^5.
The parameter k is even for each test case.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == n for (n, _), s in zip(test_cases, strings))
preconditions.description: The length of the string s matches the given length n for each test case.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in '01?' for c in s) for s in strings)
preconditions.description: Each string s consists only of the characters '0', '1', and '?'.
The sum of the lengths of all strings s does not exceed 3 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] in ['YES', 'NO'] for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((return_value[i] == 'YES') == can_be_k_balanced(n, k, s) for i, (n, k) in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: The output 'YES' is given if and only if the string s can be transformed into a k-balanced bitstring by replacing '?' with '0' or '1'.
